🔴 Welcome to Be The Biggest Streamer! 🎥

⚡ UPDATE 2 IS HERE! ⚡

Start with 0 viewers and $0… and grow your stream to become the BIGGEST streamer on Roblox! 🏆

How to Play:
🎮 Go LIVE and play 13 fun games!
👀 Play well to gain viewers: your chat goes crazy!
💵 Get donations & earn money, even offline!
🥚 Hatch eggs and collect 100+ pets, from Common to Secret!
⏰ A world event every 20 minutes
🎤 Upgrade your mic, camera & PC to multiply your viewers!
🏠 Unlock new houses and cars!

🏆 Climb the server, global & friends leaderboards!

⭐ Join Cool Game Only for an EXCLUSIVE emote! ⭐
